name: io.github.Nero-Engine/brush-pack
title: Brush Pack
description: Live listed building and conservation area checks, paint quantities and weather for decorators

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: Lists Brush Pack's tools, surfaces, paint types and what it deliberately does not do. Free, needs no input.

tools.name: paint_quantity
tools.description: Works out paint for a room (walls, ceiling, woodwork from length, width, height, doors and windows), an exterior (perimeter x height plus gables, less openings) or a custom list of areas. Shows areas, coats, indicative coverage per surface type, litres, litres with waste and the tins to buy (least paint left over, plus a fewer tins option). New plaster adds a mist coat; a light over dark colour change adds a wall coat. Coverage is indicative: pass the tin's figure as coverage_m2_per_litre to make it exact. Example: {"job":"room","length_m":4,"width_m":3.5,"height_m":2.4,"doors":1,"windows":1}.

job.description: Defaults to room, or exterior if perimeter_m is given, or custom if areas is given.

height_m.description: Wall height floor to ceiling, metres. Defaults to 2.4.

windows.description: Number of windows at the 1.2 x 1.2 m default size. Defaults to 1. Ignored if window_sizes is given.

wall_surface.description: Surface of the walls. Room default smooth_painted; exterior default masonry_smooth. smooth_painted: Previously painted smooth plaster or plasterboard (12 m2/L); new_plaster: New bare plaster (porous, needs a mist coat) (9 m2/L); bare_plasterboard: Bare plasterboard (10 m2/L); lining_paper: Lining paper (11 m2/L); textured: Textured coating or woodchip (7 m2/L); masonry_smooth: Smooth render or painted masonry (7 m2/L); masonry_rough: Pebbledash or rough cast (4 m2/L); bare_brick: Bare brick or block (5 m2/L); woodwork: Woodwork top coat (gloss, satin, eggshell) (15 m2/L); wood_primer: Primer or undercoat on bare wood (12 m2/L); metal: Metal paint (railings, gates, radiators) (12 m2/L); wood_stain: Exterior wood stain or treatment (12 m2/L)

paint_woodwork.description: Default true (skirting, door faces and frames, window frames).

woodwork_bare.description: Adds a primer or undercoat coat on the woodwork.

wall_coats.description: Defaults to 2 (plus a mist coat on new plaster).

woodwork_coats.description: Top coats on woodwork, defaults to 2.

colour_change.description: light_over_dark and strong_colour add one wall coat.

perimeter_m.description: Exterior: total length of walls to paint, metres.

gables.description: Exterior: gable triangles above the eaves line (width at the base, height to the ridge).

openings_m2.description: Exterior: total area of doors and windows to take off.

areas.description: Custom: list of { name, area_m2, surface, coats, coverage_m2_per_litre }. At most 100.

coverage_m2_per_litre.description: Spreading rate from the tin, used for every wall and ceiling line.

waste_percent.description: Added to the litres before choosing tins. Defaults to 10.

tin_sizes_l.description: Tin sizes on offer, litres. Defaults by product: emulsion 10, 5, 2.5, 1; masonry 10, 5, 2.5; trim 2.5, 1, 0.75, 0.5.

trade.description: Optional. The decorator's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1). Used to prefill quotes and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Brush Pack.

display_name.description: Trading name shown to customers, for example "Fresh Coat Decorators".

company_name.description: Registered company name, if a limited company.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 12345678 or SC123456.

licence_body.description: Trade body or accreditation the business belongs to (pda = Painting and Decorating Association).

licence_number.description: Membership or registration number with that body.

tools.name: wallpaper_rolls
tools.description: Rolls of wallpaper for a room or feature wall from wall widths (or room length and width), height, roll width and length (default 10.05 x 0.53 m), pattern repeat and match (free, straight, half drop). Shows drops, cut length, drops per roll and rolls, plus one spare. Example: {"length_m":4,"width_m":3.5,"height_m":2.4,"pattern_repeat_cm":53,"pattern_match":"straight"}.

wall_widths_m.description: Width of each wall to paper. For one feature wall give one width.

length_m.description: Room length, if papering all four walls.

width_m.description: Room width, if papering all four walls.

deduct_width_m.description: Width of near full height openings (patio doors, wide windows) to take off.

pattern_repeat_cm.description: Pattern repeat from the roll label, cm. 0 or missing means no repeat.

pattern_match.description: Defaults to straight when a repeat is given, otherwise free.

trim_allowance_cm.description: Total extra per drop for trimming top and bottom. Defaults to 10.

trade.description: Optional. The decorator's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1). Used to prefill quotes and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Brush Pack.

tools.name: lead_paint_risk
tools.description: Judges how likely old paint is to contain lead from the build year, surfaces, paint condition and any test result, checks the planned removal methods (dry sanding, blowlamps and dry scraping are refused; wet abrading, chemical strippers and heat guns below about 450 C are allowed with care), and gives the safe test, removal, clean-up and waste steps from HSE and UK guidance, plus the Control of Lead at Work duties. Returns `urgency` only if paint has already been disturbed unsafely. Example: {"build_year":1935,"surfaces":["windows","doors"],"planned_methods":["dry_sanding"],"children_under_6_or_pregnant":true}.

build_year.description: Year the home (or the painted item) was built.

era.description: Use if the exact year is unknown.

original_paint_likely.description: False if the old layers are known to have been stripped back to bare before. Default true.

children_under_6_or_pregnant.description: A child under 6 or a pregnant person lives in or visits the home.

already_disturbed.description: Old paint has already been sanded, scraped or burnt off without lead precautions.

trade.description: Optional. The decorator's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1). Used to prefill quotes and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Brush Pack.

tools.name: exterior_weather_check
tools.description: For a UK postcode (or latitude and longitude) and dates from today up to 8 days ahead, fetches the hourly forecast (MET Norway) and checks each working hour against typical limits for the paint type: minimum temperature, humidity, 3 C above dew point, rain chance, wind, and a rain-free drying time after each coat. Returns each day's verdict (good, good_but_watch_rain, marginal, no), the best painting window, the main problems and an indicative recoat time at that day's temperature. Pass the data sheet's own limits to override. Example: {"postcode":"LS1 4AP","paint_type":"water_based_masonry","start_date":"2026-11-14","end_date":"2026-11-18"}.

postcode.description: Full UK postcode of the job.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, today or later. Defaults to today.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, at most 15 days after today. Defaults to start + 6 days.

paint_type.description: water_based_masonry: Water-based masonry paint, from 8 C, humidity up to 80%, 4 h rain free; solvent_based_masonry: Solvent-based (pliolite type) masonry paint, from 5 C, humidity up to 85%, 2 h rain free; water_based_trim: Water-based exterior gloss or satin for wood, from 8 C, humidity up to 80%, 3 h rain free; solvent_based_trim: Solvent-based (oil) exterior gloss or undercoat, from 5 C, humidity up to 85%, 4 h rain free; wood_stain_water: Water-based wood stain, from 8 C, humidity up to 80%, 4 h rain free; wood_stain_solvent: Solvent-based wood stain, from 5 C, humidity up to 85%, 4 h rain free; metal_paint: Solvent-based metal paint, from 5 C, humidity up to 85%, 4 h rain free

min_temp_c.description: Minimum application temperature from the data sheet.

rain_free_hours.description: Hours the coat must stay dry after it goes on.

recoat_hours_at_20c.description: Recoat time at 20 C from the data sheet.

start_hour.description: Working day start, 24 hour clock. Defaults to 8.

tools.name: prep_checklist
tools.description: How to prepare a surface and which paint system goes on it: checks, prep steps, system (primer, undercoat, top coats) and what to avoid, for new_plaster, previously_painted_walls, bare_softwood, mdf, previously_painted_wood, exterior_wood, bare_metal_ferrous, galvanised_or_aluminium, masonry, damp_or_water_stained, smoke_or_nicotine, mould. With `cause` (fire_or_smoke, flood, active_leak, mould) it adds the making good steps and an `urgency` value. Example: {"surfaces":["new_plaster","previously_painted_wood"]}.

cause.description: Why the work is needed, if it is making good after damage.

tools.name: job_estimate
tools.description: Hours and days on site for a decorating job from rooms (same sizes as paint_quantity, with walls, ceiling and woodwork coats, new_plaster for mist coats) and extra tasks (strip_wallpaper_m2, hang_wallpaper_rolls, hang_patterned_wallpaper_rolls, masonry_smooth_m2_per_coat, masonry_rough_m2_per_coat, door_per_coat, window_per_coat, skirting_m_per_coat, custom_hours), plus prep (light, medium, heavy) and daily set up and clean up. With a day or hourly rate, materials, markup and VAT it gives a priced quote with lines. Rates are indicative for one experienced decorator. Example: {"rooms":[{"name":"Lounge","length_m":4,"width_m":3.5,"height_m":2.4}],"prep_level":"medium","day_rate_gbp":200}.

height_m.description: Wall height floor to ceiling, metres. Defaults to 2.4.

windows.description: Number of windows at the 1.2 x 1.2 m default size. Defaults to 1. Ignored if window_sizes is given.

prep_level.description: light: sound surfaces; medium: normal filling and sanding (default); heavy: lots of filling, flaking paint, caulking.

decorators.description: People on the job. Defaults to 1.

hourly_rate_gbp.description: Use instead of a day rate.

tools.name: property_check
tools.description: Looks up, live from official open data, what applies at the customer's postcode before exterior painting, a change of colour or finish, painting unpainted brick or stone, or stripping historic paint: listed buildings, conservation areas, Article 4 directions and World Heritage Sites (planning.data.gov.uk, England, councils that publish). Returns each constraint found with its source link, a plain `exterior_colour_change` answer, what each constraint means for decorating, and the council and nation. A constraint not found is not proof of none: the answer says so. Example: {"postcode":"BA1 2LR"}.

tools.name: trade_profile
tools.description: Checks the decorator's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1: trading name, Companies House number, trade body and number such as PDA or TrustMark, postcode, contact) and returns them cleaned, with a stable `nero_trade_ref` computed from the trade body membership or company number. The same object, given as `trade` to the other tools, prefills their answers. Brush Pack stores nothing. The same profile and reference can later be used to sign the business into Nero Work, the agent job exchange for trades.
